responsibility: Implements checker_path, the analyzer’s concrete diagnostic_path builder and editor. It stores checker_event sequences, supports logging/debug dumping and region-creation event insertion, fixes up event locations, records setjmp event IDs for rewind cross-references, and postprocesses paths by injecting synthetic inlined-call events derived from location inlining chains to make emitted analyzer traces match user-visible call structure.
same_name_distinction: Implements checker_path’s event-list manipulation and postprocessing declared in checker-path.h, such as logging, location fixups, region-creation insertion, and synthesis of inlined-call events in emitted paths.
